text:
Tess: Quick sync  prepping launch newsletter + benchmark webinar. Send windows: Thu 8:30AM PT (NA/EU) and Thu 8:30AM SGT (APAC). Need final subject, RSVP gating, routing, and suppressions.
Rohan: Cohorts: trial-30d, newsletter-active (30d), benchmark-downloaders (high-intent). Exclude downloaders from subject tests.
Elena: RSVP fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, demo_interest, reason (benchmark/cost/ops). Hidden utm: utm_campaign=launchpad_mailwave, source=email, cohort={cohort}.
Kai: Routing pseudo-rule:
```
if (role =~ /(Head|Director|CTO|PM|ML)/ || company_size >= 500 || cohort=="benchmark-downloaders") {
  owner = "sdr-enterprise"
} else if (cohort=="trial") {
  owner = "sdr-trial"
} else { owner = "sdr-nurture" }
```
Tess: Suppress anyone who RSVP'd/attended in past 60d, unsubscribed, or bounced. Also exclude opens in last 7d for prior benchmark mail.
Rohan: Subject test A/B: A) "Live: benchmark & ops walkthrough" B) "See how we cut inference cost — live". Preheader: "Thu 8:30AM PT  20min demo + Q&A"
Elena: Confirmation flow: RSVP -> calendar add + conditional "Book demo" when owner==sdr-enterprise or demo_interest==yes. Pass lead_score=high for downloaders.
eng-ops-bot: Note: webhook deploy scheduled Wed 19:00 PT to wire form -> CRM staging. Please QA mapping of utm, cohort, role, and lead_score.
Kai: I'll export segments to /marketing/seg-exports/launchpad-mailwave and flag APAC recipients by EOD.
Tess: Owners: Elena (form + copy), Kai (routing + segments), Rohan (suppression + subject tests), eng-ops-bot (deploy). We'll do a 15m pre-send Wed 3PM PT. Ping when staging pass is green. :white_check_mark:
